speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are here for evaluation of delayed menarche, unusual physical features, and a history of bone fragility. To begin, have you been diagnosed with any specific genetic conditions or syndromes previously?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (likely 21-hydroxylase deficiency). 

The combination of ambiguous genitalia (partial labial fusion, clitoromegaly) at birth, signs of androgen excess (hirsutism, severe acne), and bone fragility in an adolescent female strongly suggests a diagnosis of Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia. I will need to confirm this with a 17-hydroxyprogesterone level. REQUEST TEST: 17_hydroxyprogesterone_level.
